note: Every source COP shows, with its licence and whether a paid COP could use it (Tom, 31 Oct 2026: a paid tier is possible later). commercial_ok is true, false or unknown; basis says why. The free public picture uses everything; the flag drives nothing yet. snapshot.py lists any source id seen in a feed but missing here as unregistered, so a new upstream (for example a non-commercial one) can't slip into a paid tier unnoticed. Tom reviews every value before anyone pays.

gworkspace-status.basis: Google Workspace's status feed carries no licence, as Blackout records it; Blackout carries the incident title, products, times and a link. Check the provider's site terms before a sale.

apple-status.licence: No licence for the status data; facts and link only
apple-status.basis: Apple's website Terms of Use bar republishing site content without Apple's consent (apple.com/legal/internet-services/terms/site.html, as Blackout records it, read 13 Nov 2026); Blackout carries only the affected services, status type and times with a link, never Apple's wording. Likely needs Apple's consent for a paid use; ask or drop before a sale.

akamai-status.name: Akamai Status incident history (RSS), via Blackout
akamai-status.licence: No licence stated; facts and link only
akamai-status.basis: Akamai's status feed carries no licence, as Blackout records it; Blackout reads the RSS because the site's robots.txt disallows /api/, leaves out security advisories, and carries the title, status, times and a link. Check the provider's site terms before a sale.

slack-status.name: Slack Status API (current incidents), via Blackout
slack-status.licence: No licence stated; facts and link only
slack-status.basis: Slack's status API carries no licence, as Blackout records it; Blackout carries the incident title, type, status, affected services, times and a link. Slack is part of Salesforce. Check the provider's site terms before a sale.

zoom-status.name: Zoom status incident history (RSS), via Blackout
zoom-status.licence: No licence stated; facts and link only
zoom-status.basis: Zoom's status feed carries no licence, as Blackout records it; Blackout reads the RSS because the site's robots.txt disallows /api/, and carries the title, status, times and a link. Check the provider's site terms before a sale.

cloudflare-radar.name: Cloudflare Radar outage annotations and verified traffic anomalies, via Blackout
cloudflare-radar.basis: Radar's API data is made available under CC BY-NC 4.0 (developers.cloudflare.com/radar, read 13 Nov 2026): non-commercial only, with attribution. Blackout quotes Cloudflare's outage descriptions and causes.

cloudflare-radar-bgp.name: Cloudflare Radar BGP hijack and route-leak detection, via Blackout
cloudflare-radar-bgp.basis: Same Radar API and licence as cloudflare-radar (developers.cloudflare.com/radar, read 13 Nov 2026): non-commercial only, with attribution. Blackout carries Cloudflare's event facts (networks, prefixes, peers, times, Cloudflare's evidence tags).

iaea-ukraine-updates.name: IAEA Director General statements on the situation in Ukraine (Zaporizhzhya NPP off-site power), via Blackout

accessnow-stop.licence: No licence stated for the data; credited, counts only

Blackout shows counts and stated causes as context only. Ask Access Now before a sale.

citizenlab-test-lists.name: Citizen Lab and Others, URL Testing Lists Intended for Discovering Website Censorship, via Blackout
citizenlab-test-lists.basis: The repository's README: all data is provided under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (github.com/citizenlab/test-lists, as Blackout records it, read 13 Nov 2026): non-commercial only. Blackout shows counts per country and category.

odin-ornl.name: ODIN, Outage Data Initiative Nationwide (Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the US Department of Energy), via Blackout
odin-ornl.licence: No licence stated; credited to ODIN and the reporting utilities
odin-ornl.basis: ODIN states no licence for its public outage data (API docs, site and Feb 2026 webinar, as Blackout records them, read 13 Nov 2026). The data are the reporting utilities' own; a federal laboratory runs the service. Ask ORNL before a sale.

census-gazetteer-counties.name: US Census Bureau 2025 Gazetteer county points, via Blackout
census-gazetteer-counties.basis: A US Government work (Census Bureau), in the public domain; Blackout uses it only to place ODIN's counties.

nasa-black-marble.name: NASA Black Marble VJ146A2 night lights (VIIRS, NOAA-20), via Blackout
nasa-black-marble.licence: NASA Earth science data: no restrictions on use, citation requested; LANCE near-real-time data as is
nasa-black-marble.basis: NASA's Earth science data policy as Blackout records it: no restrictions on the use of these data, citation requested; near-real-time data provided as is under the LANCE disclaimer (earthdata.nasa.gov, read 13 Nov 2026). Blackout publishes its own measurement from the radiance. Recheck the citation wording before a sale.

eia-930.name: U.S. Energy Information Administration EIA-930 hourly demand and day-ahead forecasts, via Blackout
eia-930.licence: Public domain (US Government publication); acknowledged as Source: U.S. Energy Information Administration
eia-930.basis: EIA: U.S. government publications are in the public domain and are not subject to copyright protection; it asks for an acknowledgement with the date (eia.gov/about/copyrights_reuse.php, read 13 Nov 2026). Blackout publishes its own measurement of each balancing authority's demand against its forecast, with that acknowledgement.

ecb-eurofxref.name: European Central Bank euro foreign exchange reference rates, via Headwind
ecb-eurofxref.licence: ECB statistics: free reuse with the source credited
ecb-eurofxref.basis: The ECB's disclaimer page allows free use with the ECB cited as the source and says a change to the figures must be stated (read by Headwind's session, 13 Nov 2026). Headwind restates the rates per US dollar and says so.

eia-spot.name: U.S. Energy Information Administration daily spot prices (Brent, WTI, Henry Hub), via Headwind
eia-spot.licence: US public domain (EIA); EIA asks to be credited as the source
eia-spot.basis: EIA: U.S. government publications are in the public domain; its API terms allow a service that displays and analyses its data, with EIA named as the source and no endorsement implied (read by Headwind's session, 13 Nov 2026).

fao-ffpi.name: FAO Food Price Index, via Headwind
fao-ffpi.licence: CC BY 4.0 (FAO database terms of use)
fao-ffpi.basis: FAO's database terms give CC BY 4.0 unless a dataset's page says otherwise, and bar use for or in conjunction with the promotion of a commercial enterprise; the index's own page shows no licence statement (read by Headwind's session, 13 Nov 2026). Check that bar before any paid use.

wfp-food-prices-hdx.name: World Food Programme food prices by market, via the Humanitarian Data Exchange and Headwind
wfp-food-prices-hdx.basis: CC BY-IGO read from HDX's own metadata (Headwind's session, 12 Nov 2026). The licence's version and WFP's own terms were not read for commercial use; check before any paid use.

us-federal-register.name: US Federal Register API (BIS and OFAC rules and proposed rules), via Headwind
us-federal-register.basis: The National Archives' page about the Federal Register says everything that appears in it may be reproduced without restriction (read by Headwind's session, 13 Nov 2026).

ofac-sdn.name: US Treasury OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, via Headwind
ofac-sdn.basis: A US Government work, stated from memory in Headwind's notes; Treasury's site-policies page had no reuse statement (13 Nov 2026). Headwind carries counts of changes and names vessels only.

un-sc-consolidated.name: United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, via Headwind
un-sc-consolidated.licence: UN website terms of use (personal, non-commercial use; no redistribution). Headwind publishes counts only
un-sc-consolidated.basis: The UN's website terms allow copying for personal, non-commercial use and withhold redistribution and derivative works; the list page states no licence of its own (read by Headwind's session, 13 Nov 2026). Headwind publishes only counts and a link.

trade-gov-csl.name: US International Trade Administration Consolidated Screening List, via Headwind
trade-gov-csl.basis: A US Government work, stated from memory in Headwind's notes; its page states no terms of reuse (read 13 Nov 2026). Headwind carries counts of changes only.

ornl-eaglei-history.name: ORNL EAGLE-I outage history 2014-2025 (Brelsford et al., figshare doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.24237376), via Blackout
ornl-eaglei-history.basis: The figshare record states CC BY 4.0 (read through its API, 13 Nov 2026), as does the data descriptor (Scientific Data 11:271, 2024). Commercial use allowed with attribution and a note of changes: Blackout reduces 2018-2025 to state base rates (how often a state had more than 50,000 customers out for an hour or more) and credits Brelsford et al. and ORNL.

census-gazetteer-2025-counties.name: US Census Bureau, 2025 Gazetteer Files, counties (internal points), COP's own copy in config/us_counties.json for outage triage
census-gazetteer-2025-counties.basis: A US Government work (17 U.S.C. 105). COP uses the county internal points to place hazards in US states; the copy is Blackout's (blackout/us_counties.json, downloaded 13 Nov 2026), whose source line names the file.

gcat-mcdowell.name: Jonathan McDowell's General Catalog of Artificial Space Objects (GCAT), via Orbit
gcat-mcdowell.licence: CC BY 4.0; cite as 'Data from GCAT (J. McDowell, planet4589.org/space/gcat)'
gcat-mcdowell.basis: CC BY 4.0 as the GCAT page states (read by Orbit's session, 13 Nov 2026), which allows commercial use with that citation. Orbit reads the catalogs once a day and only when they change, from McDowell's own server.

ll2-thespacedevs.licence: Free access stated by The Space Devs; no data licence stated. Credited; images not used
ll2-thespacedevs.basis: The Space Devs offer free access to the whole database (15 requests an hour without a key) but state no data licence (read by Orbit's session, 13 Nov 2026). Check their terms before any paid use.

faa-tfr.name: FAA Temporary Flight Restrictions (tfr.faa.gov), space operations, via Launch
faa-tfr.licence: US Government work (17 U.S.C. 105); no licence stated on the site
faa-tfr.basis: US Government work, as Launch's doctrine/sources.json records (read 13 Nov 2026)

space-track.name: Space-Track.org (United States Space Command, USSPACECOM, 18th Space Defense Squadron) element sets, via Orbit
space-track.licence: USSPACECOM's blanket approval to redistribute basic SSA data, conditioned on citation; analysis cited too. Each item carries Orbit's approved citation
space-track.basis: As Orbit's doctrine/sources.json and doctrine/spacetrack-disclaimer.md record (read 14 Nov 2026; wording approved by Tom). Orbit's account; raw element sets are not republished, only Orbit's own orbit-change analysis.

meta-threat-research.licence: MIT (LICENSE file and README); network summaries quoted with Meta's MIT notice
meta-threat-research.basis: MIT allows commercial use with the copyright and permission notice, as Undertow's doctrine/sources.json records (read 14 Nov 2026). Undertow keeps operation-level facts, counts and Meta's network summary, never indicator values.

google-iob.basis: Google's terms are ambiguous on automated reading and state no data licence; robots.txt disallows only search paths. Tom's decision of 14 Nov 2026: automate, facts and counts only (Undertow's doctrine/sources.json).

disinfocode-tiktok.basis: No licence stated, as Undertow's doctrine/sources.json records (14 Nov 2026). TikTok's own site terms bar automated extraction without written approval; Tom's permission email is drafted, not sent.

eeas-fimi-4.name: EEAS 4th report on FIMI threats (March 2026), named Information Manipulation Sets, via Undertow

eeas-fimi-4.basis: The legal notice as Undertow's doctrine/sources.json records it (14 Nov 2026) authorises reuse with acknowledgement and states no non-commercial limit. Not reread by COP.

dfrlab-rss.name: Atlantic Council's Digital Forensic Research Lab (DFRLab) RSS feed, articles naming an operation Undertow already tracks, via Undertow

disarm-1.6.1.basis: CC BY-SA 4.0 allows commercial use with attribution; adaptations must keep the same licence. Undertow's technique mapping is its own and is still proposed, not reviewed (14 Nov 2026).

imf-portwatch.name: IMF PortWatch Daily Chokepoints Data (International Monetary Fund and University of Oxford), via Wake
imf-portwatch.licence: IMF terms of use: IMF Data may be downloaded, published and distributed with attribution, a material transformation stated, and no IMF endorsement implied; bulk or systematic downloading by automated means needs the IMF's written permission
imf-portwatch.basis: As Wake's config/sources.json and notes record (terms read 15 Nov 2026). The terms allow reuse with attribution and state no non-commercial limit, but Wake's permission request for automated pulls is not yet sent, so Wake collects by hand weekly. Not reread by COP.
